migrationRequests.sql:
-- UC-CASE-004 — one link row per (case, evidence) pair, enforced by the database.
-- 1) de-duplicate: keep the earliest link of each pair (its role/provenance), drop later duplicates.
DELETE FROM "case_evidence_links" l
 USING "case_evidence_links" k
 WHERE l."case_id" = k."case_id"
   AND l."evidence_id" = k."evidence_id"
   AND (l."linked_at_utc", l."id") > (k."linked_at_utc", k."id");
-- 2) the invariant.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "case_evidence_links_case_id_evidence_id_key"
  ON "case_evidence_links" ("case_id", "evidence_id");
migrationRequests.prisma: model CaseEvidenceLink: replace `@@unique([caseId, evidenceId, role])` with `@@unique([caseId, evidenceId])` (the old 3-column unique becomes redundant; drop its index "case_evidence_links_case_id_evidence_id_role_key" in the same migration if the lead prefers one constraint).

migrationRequests.sql:
-- UC-COM-004 — at most one ACTIVE entitlement per user.
-- 1) merge duplicates: the newest active row keeps the summed credits of the others, which are deactivated.
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT "id", "user_id", "credits",
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY "user_id" ORDER BY "created_at" DESC, "id" DESC) AS rn
    FROM "entitlements" WHERE "active" = true
), extra AS (
  SELECT "user_id", SUM("credits") AS credits FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1 GROUP BY "user_id"
)
UPDATE "entitlements" e
   SET "credits" = e."credits" + extra.credits
  FROM ranked r JOIN extra ON extra."user_id" = r."user_id"
 WHERE r.rn = 1 AND e."id" = r."id";
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT "id", row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY "user_id" ORDER BY "created_at" DESC, "id" DESC) AS rn
    FROM "entitlements" WHERE "active" = true
)
UPDATE "entitlements" SET "active" = false WHERE "id" IN (SELECT "id" FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1);
-- 2) the invariant.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "entitlements_user_id_active_key"
  ON "entitlements" ("user_id") WHERE "active" = true;
migrationRequests.prisma: none expressible (partial unique index WHERE active); add a /// comment on model Entitlement naming entitlements_user_id_active_key. Review: duplicate active rows are merged by summing credits into the newest and deactivating the rest.
